framing: A pair filing a lens value as its own subject. Everything else about it is well formed, so the only errors this root may raise on the pair layer are the lens ones - which is the point: it pins the pairs call site, not the shared helper.

A pair asserting federalism as both its subject and a lens over itself. Either axis alone would be legal, which is why this needs its own name and its own fixture rather than sharing one with lens-as-subject.
